scope: Offline design exploration only; no production, backend, CLI or MCP mutations.

method.browser: Managed Chromium, then a dedicated headless Chromium/CDP browser after shared-tool contention.
method.interaction: Rendered controls exercised with native Puppeteer mouse, keyboard and typing events. No application functions or model writes were used to advance gameplay.
method.mobile: Final surface matrix uses mobile emulation with touch at 375x667 and 390x844. Early light manual runs used a 390x844 desktop viewport with a 15px scrollbar; full-page images contain its 375px content area.
method.textResize: 200% text stress doubles each element’s computed font size before measuring and capturing; this is text resizing, not a claim about a specific browser zoom implementation.
method.validation: Browser exercise only. No formatter, linter, build, unit test or project-wide suite was run.

layoutStress.nameMethod: The real full-room fixture was rendered first, then only displayed name text was substituted in the DOM to stress all eight long names simultaneously.

passModes: Dark with reduced=1 after privacy and reader-count correction
manualFlow.invalidAttemptResult: Below-target and above-target input in every round left Send disabled and remained on the writing surface.

interactionProof.entry: Whitespace-only host name rejected; code normalized to FOLD; Enter on code focuses name; invitation is read-only and initially focuses name. Joined participant has no host Start action, including after presentation return; created host is correctly identified in roster.
interactionProof.keyboard: Six forward Tab steps and reverse Tab remained in the dialog. Escape restored the help/settings trigger. Dialog title has one matching ID. State updates retain their triggering action focus, or main when the action disappears.
interactionProof.privacy: Canceled/failed delivery remains private; successful-delivery preview alone displays the public-preview claim; revocation restores private state. A one-poem manual sketch no longer invents a second sample poem in session sharing. No real publication occurred.
interactionProof.reading: Favorite no longer replays the poem aperture or covers lines with a success toast. Attribution remains until explicitly dismissed; all nine lines stay present. Toasts clear on view navigation.
interactionProof.motion: Observed 400ms named-seat settle, 550ms accepted-paper settle, 600ms whole-sheet opening, 180ms guide/tool/attribution fade, 300ms private-heart acknowledgement and a 2px pointer press. Reduced mode suppresses these without withholding content.

fixes.change: Paper-stack backing layers now render as offset edges instead of painting over the front sheet. Stack, sheet and folded waiting states retain their original paper identity.
Narrow social artwork becomes one column rather than breaking ordinary words across two cramped columns. Help steps keep their intended spacing outside dialogs.
Dark fox/whale paper fills are lighter, preserving readable companion silhouettes against blue-hour sheets.
Local host/participant permissions, host badge, own name in presentation, full-room seat count and spectator end-game controls are consistent.
Acceptance/reveal motion belongs to the actual transition, not every rerender. Favorites and attribution no longer refold the whole poem; quiet success feedback does not obscure reading.
Motion inventory uses the real composer, roster, poem, controls and dialogs instead of generic policy placards. Actual control actions produce the represented response.
Dialog Tab boundaries wrap, Escape returns focus, guide title IDs no longer collide, and state rerenders preserve keyboard focus.
Invitation/code keyboard focus is correct and Your poems remains reachable through mobile footer navigation.
Sharing preview copy stays private until successful delivery; the manual one-poem session stays one poem in sharing and the reread circle. Stale notifications clear on navigation.
Removed the unused folding keyframe/rule and updated the direction’s verification limitation statement.

visualReview.judgment: The original three-line narrow-home title is retained: both Host and Join remain visible at 375x667, so a generic heading restyle was unwarranted. Writing remains one upright sheet; waiting is one accepted fold; reading exposes every line. The paper stack, ribbon and companions remain distinctive.

unexercisedLimits: No real phone, software keyboard, physical projector, screen-reader or cross-browser audit. Short-height and 200% text checks are explicitly emulated layout stress.
The optional cue was invoked and its Web Audio context observed running, but audio was not actually heard; sound quality remains unverified.
No actual live room, other player, network recovery, authentication, persistence or publication. Account/public fixtures remain explicitly offline.
Native OS sharing, printing and saving surfaces were not exercised; their rendered controls are not claimed as integrated platform proof.
toolingNotes: Managed fill/click helpers timed out despite visible targets. Native Puppeteer mouse/keyboard actions in a dedicated Chromium browser completed the interactions.
A shared Eval VM was reset by a browser-tool timeout. This worker requested no reset; persisted navigation data and screenshots were recovered.
Pre-fix defaults, core-before, manual-reveal and utility-interaction artifacts intentionally preserve discovered failures. Use the final evidence paths above for acceptance.
Temporary image-composition probes were removed; no smoke-test script or project test scaffold was retained.
